thread:
divya: Morning — async standup. Quick notes:
- Done: landed the sample app CLI docs updates (README + quickstart commands), fixed the Windows path examples. Pushed PR #482.
- Blockers: CI flake on macOS wheel build — failing at `pip install -e .` step intermittently. Haven't reproduced locally yet.
- Today: triage that CI flake, review @lee's quickstart edits, and prep a tiny patch for embedder example to include deterministic seed.

lee: thanks — I'll take a look at the quickstart edits now. small ask: can we make the Docker example use `redwood/runner:stable` instead of `latest`? avoids surprises.

sam: re: CI mac flake — saw something similar on a different repo last week, usually caused by transient network/timeouts to the wheel index. can you add `--no-use-pep517` to the pip command in .github/workflows/test.yml as a quick experiment?

divya: good idea, sam. I can try that and rerun the failing job. also adding `pip --retries 10 --timeout 120` to be safe.

priya: ping on the embedder example — do we want the seed parameter to live in the quickstart or just in the sampleapp tests? i prefer quickstart so users see deterministic output in docs.

divya: agreed — put it in the quickstart and mirror it in tests. will add a short note about determinism in the README.

docs-bot: CI notice: workflow `python-tests` for divya/sampleapp-docs (PR #482) failed on runner `macos-latest` with job `build-wheel` at 2026-03-17T09:12:34Z. Please re-run when ready.

lee: fyi I'm rebasing my edits and will request review from @priya in ~30m. small nit: can we update the command example to use `--model redwood/fast-1` (matches hosted catalog) instead of the generic `mymodel`?

divya: yup, will switch to `redwood/fast-1`. Also adding a short troubleshooting section for the Docker port mapping (users hit it often).

sam: once you push the CI tweak I can re-run the mac job and watch for flakes. I can also open a follow-up issue to track a longer-term fix if it persists.

divya: great — plan: push CI tweak now, update quickstart with seed + model, and ping when PR updated. thanks team :chef-kiss:
